text:
maria (Docs): Quick sync: infra made Request-Id the canonical idempotency header on v2. We need tiny migration notes + snippets.

samir (SDK): Understood. Is Idempotency-Key rejected?

maria (Docs): No — supported for 90 days with a Warning header. After that it will be removed. Show both usages.

clem (Frontend): Our example client uses idempotencyKey. I'll switch snippets to requestId and keep a one-release shim.

samir (SDK): I'll implement mapping idempotencyKey -> requestId and emit a deprecation warning. Draft PR: SDK #7999. Snippets below you can copy.

samir (SDK): ```js
// old
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-7b', prompt: 'hi', idempotencyKey: uid })
// new
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-7b', prompt: 'hi', requestId: uid })
```

samir (SDK): ```py
# old
client.generate(model='redwood-7b', prompt='hi', idempotency_key=uid)
# new
client.generate(model='redwood-7b', prompt='hi', request_id=uid)
```

maria (Docs): Add raw HTTP too for infra teams. Also include WARNING header example.

maria (Docs): ```http
POST /v2/generate HTTP/1.1
Request-Id: 123e4567-... 
Content-Type: application/json

{ "model": "redwood-7b", "input": "..." }
```

maria (Docs): Example response when Idempotency-Key is used: `Warning: 299 \"Idempotency-Key deprecated; use Request-Id\"`.

jen (QA): I'll add two smoke tests: (1) same Request-Id twice -> deduped, (2) Idempotency-Key -> accepted + Warning header. Plan PR: #8001.

clem (Frontend): Example repo PR: frontend-examples#113. I'll keep a shim with console.warn.

alex (Support): I'll draft a KB showing how to spot the warning in logs and how to patch middleware.

docs-bot: Suggested changelog entry under Unreleased -> Note: v2 idempotency header renamed to Request-Id; Idempotency-Key supported with deprecation warning for transition window.

infra-bot: Canary: emits Warning header when Idempotency-Key present. Monitoring will report rate.

maria (Docs): Action list: samir open SDK PR (#7999), jen smoke tests (#8001), clem example PR (#113), alex support KB draft after docs merge, me: update migration guide + verify checklist. Target: merge all 48h before email.

samir (SDK): Aiming to merge in 24-36h. Will tag reviewers.

jen (QA): I'll reserve CI slot for smoke tests once PRs are open.

maria (Docs): Thanks all ":thumbsup:" — I'll open the docs PR and paste these snippets.
